title: When one expert gets every token
summary: Name router collapse and the usual loss that spreads tokens.

choices.text: The experts overfit to their first batches. Raise the router temperature until routing is nearly uniform, and average all eight experts instead of taking the top one.
The router's learning rate is too high. Freeze the router after warmup so the assignment stays fixed and each expert specializes on what it already receives.
The router collapsed onto one expert. Add a load-balancing term that penalizes an uneven token mix, often together with a per-expert capacity.
One expert is simply the best one. Prune the seven idle experts and keep the winner, since a dense layer of the same size performs the same.
